weakness: Accounting SaaS administrator account (W-9s with SSNs, bank feed) uses a reused password and no MFA
remediation_plan: Turn on MFA; unique passphrase in a new password manager; remove W-9 PDFs from the file account
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested; password manager in use
resources_required: Owner time (2 hours); password manager about $60 a year

weakness: AI trial account and engineering software license portal use a password only
source: P03 G-016 (Client A addendum s.2); P02 control statement
remediation_plan: Close the AI account after the vendor confirms deletion; turn on MFA for the license portal
milestones: 2026-09-30 license portal MFA on; AI account closed after deletion confirmation

weakness: USB backup drive is unencrypted and holds client data from 4 projects and an SSI copy
remediation_plan: Buy a hardware-encrypted drive; copy non-SSI working files to it; wipe and physically destroy the old drive; record the destruction
milestones: 2026-09-15 new drive in use; old drive destroyed and recorded

weakness: SSI printout and the backup drive in an unlocked drawer; no secure container; no destruction method
source: P07 assessment (MP-04 objectives); P03 G-004 (49 CFR 1520.9(a)(1))
remediation_plan: Locking file cabinet for SSI paper and the backup drive; shred the SSI printout unless needed; cross-cut shredder; SSI register
milestones: 2026-09-30 cabinet installed and printout locked or shredded; register started
resources_required: Cabinet and shredder about $250 one time

weakness: Zone drawing received unmarked and left unmarked; draft review quoting SSI unmarked
source: P07 assessment (MP-03a.); P03 G-007 and G-009
remediation_plan: Mark both records under 1520.13; move SSI details to a marked appendix; confirm with Client A
milestones: 2026-09-15 both marked; 2026-09-30 Client A confirms the appendix approach

weakness: Monthly manual backup to an unencrypted, never-tested drive kept next to the laptop
remediation_plan: Weekly copy to the encrypted drive, disconnected after each copy and kept in the cabinet; quarterly restore test of one project folder
milestones: 2026-09-21 first weekly copy; 2026-10-30 first restore test recorded

weakness: AI tool used with Client A data on free-trial terms; subcontractors without security terms or client approval; no vendor list
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-018 and G-019
remediation_plan: Deletion request to the AI vendor; vendor and approved-services list; short subcontractor security terms; ask Client A to approve the GIS subcontractor in writing
milestones: 2026-09-30 deletion request sent and vendor list done; 2026-10-30 subcontractor terms signed and Client A decision received
resources_required: Owner time; attorney review of subcontractor terms about $300

weakness: Client data from finished projects kept past the contract period; no destruction certificates
source: P07 assessment (SI-12[01] and SI-12[02]); P03 G-021
remediation_plan: Return or destroy data from the three finished projects; send Client A a certificate for its 2024 project; project close-out checklist (POL-01 8.8)
milestones: 2026-10-30 old data destroyed and certificates sent

weakness: No incident reporting times or notification list
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-011, G-020, G-030
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print contacts; put contacts in the phone; walkthrough with the IT support contractor
resources_required: Owner time; IT support contractor 1 hour

weakness: No review or update cycle for the risk assessment
remediation_plan: POL-01 4.3 sets an annual August review and change triggers; first update August 2027
